stackDivergence.rationale: Original comprehensive internal cppumaker DisposedException value derives from the existing shared RuntimeException/Exception owner. Default/two-field constructors initialize the base before the derived type; implicit copies/moves and inherited assignments retain actual stable OUString/Reference fields and reverse destruction. Generated derived type initialization uses actual shared typelib factory/register/release with the real RuntimeException base and leaked cached Type. Native JS catch/finally represents typed catch and caught object lifetime over actual generated hierarchy, without a second type/value/default provider. Complete genuine normal-ASan/UBSan native streams and source-absent whole raw100 checks are required. Physical ABI, allocator/resource, native threading/shutdown, source-location/debug/external-only headers and complete consumer QA remain unverified; generic exception bridge and weak object/services/Calc document/edit/view/UI remain subsequent. Broad parity flags stay false.
